Name: SVE Portrait Resprites
Author: CherrySymphony
Description:
These sprites have essentially been redone and moved into SVE itself. I'm leaving this mod up in case anyone likes my versions more, but they're not compatible with the Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod and likely will not receive any further updates.


Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for letting me edit and upload these sprites!

This mod replaces the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=description]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] OC character portraits for Andy, Victor, and Olivia to one's I thought were more uniform with the Stardew Valley style.
I may add more portrait resprites as more OCs are added to SVE!


To Install:
Copy the unzipped file to the Stardew Mods folder.

If you have any problems using these sprites, please let me know!
